description: This file defines the Zend_Json_Encoder class responsible for encoding PHP data structures into JSON format, including handling objects, arrays, and basic data types. It also provides methods for encoding PHP classes into JavaScript class2 format.

classes.name: Zend_Json_Encoder
classes.description: A class for encoding PHP data structures into JSON format, including support for objects, arrays, and PHP class-to-JavaScript class2 encoding.

methods.name: encode
methods.description: Encodes a PHP value into JSON, with optional cycle check.

methods.name: _encodeValue
methods.description: Recursively encodes a value based on its type (object, array, or datum).

methods.name: _encodeObject
methods.description: Encodes a PHP object into JSON, including class name and properties, with cycle detection.

methods.name: _wasVisited
methods.description: Checks if an object has already been serialized to prevent cycles.

methods.name: _encodeArray
methods.description: Encodes a PHP array into JSON, distinguishing between indexed and associative arrays.

methods.name: _encodeDatum
methods.description: Encodes a basic data type (string, number, boolean, null) into JSON.

methods.name: _encodeString
methods.description: Escapes special characters in a string for JSON encoding.

methods.name: _encodeConstants
methods.description: Encodes class constants into JSON in class2 format.

methods.name: _encodeMethods
methods.description: Encodes class methods into JSON in class2 format.

methods.name: _encodeVariables
methods.description: Encodes class properties into JSON in class2 format.

methods.name: encodeClass
methods.description: Encodes a PHP class into JavaScript class2 format.

methods.name: encodeClasses
methods.description: Encodes multiple PHP classes into JavaScript class2 format.
